accounting_rules: Reserve a slot and its full bound before transmission.
A transmitted or possibly transmitted request remains consumed.
Missing provider usage is UNKNOWN, never zero.
UTC rollover never resets cumulative experiment counters.
Every fixed request is counted locally under the pinned Harmony format; every realised revision and recheck is exact-counted immediately before transmission.
No evidence is truncated, split, substituted or weakened to fit a limit.
Each UTC day must independently fit available free allowance after other account usage.
No previous authority or allowance exception transfers.
The 2,560-token checker allowance covers reasoning and answer output; concise response fields reduce but do not eliminate live truncation uncertainty.
